kultivator.trial.title: Heart Demon
kultivator.trial.subtitle.breakthrough: Your own shadow blocks the path to the heavens
kultivator.trial.start.breakthrough: Before the heavens judge you, your own heart steps forward. Defeat your Heart Demon within %s seconds, and do not let it break you! If your health falls below 20%%, you lose.
kultivator.trial.start.pressure: The pressure on your heart has taken shape! Defeat your Heart Demon within %s seconds. If your health falls below 20%%, you lose.
kultivator.trial.warning: Your heart trembles... something dark is stirring beneath your thoughts. Stand on firm ground.
kultivator.trial.taunt.0: So this is the Dao heart you are so proud of, %s?
kultivator.trial.taunt.1: I am every fear you swallowed and every doubt you buried.
kultivator.trial.taunt.2: %s failed breakthroughs... I remember every single one. Do you?
kultivator.trial.taunt.3: You dare reach for %s with a heart like this?
kultivator.trial.taunt.4: Strike me, and you strike yourself.
kultivator.trial.taunt.5: Your qi trembles. Your hands tremble. Give in.
kultivator.trial.taunt.6: Kneel, %s. I will walk the Dao in your place.
kultivator.trial.taunt.7: I was born in your meditation, in every breath you could not calm.
kultivator.trial.taunt.8: The heavens are watching. Shall we show them how weak you are?
kultivator.trial.taunt.9: Go back to being a mortal. It was so much easier, was it not?
kultivator.trial.taunt.10: Your face, your qi, your name... soon all of it will be mine, %s.
kultivator.trial.taunt.11: Every shortcut, every pill, every greedy step. I grew fat on all of them.
kultivator.trial.won.title: Firm Dao Heart
kultivator.trial.won.subtitle: Your Heart Demon shatters into nothing
kultivator.trial.won.breakthrough: You shattered your Heart Demon and your wounds close! Your Dao heart stands firm: +%s Stored Qi and a better breakthrough awaits.
kultivator.trial.won.pressure: The Heart Demon is quelled. The qi it stole flows back into you (+%s cultivation), and your next breakthrough will go better.
kultivator.trial.lost.overwhelmed: Your Heart Demon pins you down. Your will breaks before your body can.
kultivator.trial.lost.timeout: Time runs out. Your Heart Demon sinks back into your heart, stronger than before.
kultivator.trial.lost.fled: You fled from your own heart. The demon simply follows you inward.
kultivator.trial.lost.pressure: The Heart Demon tears through your meridians!
kultivator.trial.lost.pending: The Heart Demon you left behind was waiting for you.
kultivator.trial.died: You fell while your Heart Demon still stood. It will be waiting.
kultivator.trial.cleared: The Heart Demon dissolves into nothing.
death.attack.kultivator_heart_demon.play: %1$s was struck down by their Heart Demon while fighting %2$s
kultivator.trial.debug.busy: %s cannot face a Heart Demon right now (dead, spectator, breaking through or already in a trial).
kultivator.trial.debug.failed: The Heart Demon could not appear here.
kultivator.trial.debug.creative: Note: a Heart Demon never attacks a player in Creative mode.
kultivator.trial.debug.pressure_set: Heart demon pressure of %s is now %s.
kultivator.trial.debug.pressure_show: Heart demon pressure of %s: %s / 100 (Heart Demons defeated: %s).
kultivator.trial.debug.cleared: The Heart Demon of %s was dispelled.

Lose to your own Heart Demon
advancement.kultivator.still_heart.title: Still as a Mountain Lake
advancement.kultivator.inner_demon_quell: Defeat a Heart Demon born from the pressure on your heart
